text:
emma: Quick follow-up from today's arch sync — proposing a deferred verification circuit: accept-on-prefilter then async bench + progressive lift. Want to capture interface, failure modes, and a few new knobs (prefilter confidence, bench credits).

rohan: Sounds good. Key constraints: minimize wasted bench GPU time, avoid letting bad models serve, and keep the path auditable. Two immediate levers: 1) stronger prefilter (but cheap), 2) tight rollout windows with automatic rollback triggers.

kat: Suggest a "prefilter confidence" score (0-1) that intake returns. If <0.6 require manual approval or extra smoke probes. Prefilter consists of: tokenization-hash match, forward-shape, 30-item smoke gold, and a tiny embedding-sanity check. Should be <20s.

emma: I like that. Also want bench-run "attestation": bench infra signs result with bench_run_id and bench_signature so intake/routing can verify results haven't been tampered with. Bench webhook must include bench_signature.

bench-bot: enqueued bench job: candidate=cand-1812349999, est_gpu_hours=3.0, priority=normal, expected_done=~6h, webhook=/hooks/bench/result.

rohan: Lifecycle we discussed: submitted -> prefilter_ok -> queued_verify -> verifying -> shadowing -> canary -> promoted | quarantined | rejected. Add a "limited_lift" intermediary: small internal-only traffic for feature teams while verifying external metrics.

kat: For golden sets, we should track lineage: golden_id + parent_gold_chain (list) + commit_hash. Store these in candidate metadata. Bench must echo golden_id and include golden_commit in the result payload. Runtime refuses promotion if candidate.golden_commit != bench.golden_commit.

emma: On bench verdicts, define simple enums: pass | warn | fail. Actions: pass -> schedule shadowing; warn -> quarantined_pending_owner or limited_lift with guardrails; fail -> immediate quarantine and rollback if routing present. Warn should carry remediations (e.g., "embedding cosine drop 0.18; consider retokenize or update probe").

rohan: Rollout recipe: post-pass do shadowing 12-24h, collect traffic-level telemetry (latency, error-rate, qualitative signals), then limited_lift (internal 0.1%) for 6-12h, then external canary 0.1%->1% ramp. Bench veto or telemetry signal can halt and trigger rollback.

kat: Add a cron rebench: periodic re-eval (weekly or on golden update) to catch silent drift. Rebench results should be attached to model history and can trigger re-quarantine.

emma: API sketches: ingest returns candidate_id and prefilter_score. Bench webhook payload keys (minimal) below. Example:```json
{
  "candidate_id": "cand-1812349999",
  "verdict": "warn",
  "failed_checks": ["regression:longtail-v2"],
  "drift_metric": "0.29",
  "p95_ms": "330",
  "golden_id": "gold-2026-05-03-b",
  "golden_commit": "c0ff33ab",
  "bench_run_id": "bench-2026-55",
  "bench_signature": "sig:v1:ABCD...",
  "artifacts_url": "https://bench.internal/r/bench-2026-55",
  "summary": "embedding_cosine_drop=0.18; qa_f1_drop=2.3%"
}
```

ops-bot: Operational knobs: org_daily_bench_credits, per_candidate_gpu_cap, priority_tiers, pending_TTL (default 48h), bench_TTL (default 72h). If credits exhausted, intake should mark candidate "queued_manual" and surface expedite request flow (requires two approvers).

rohan: If bench result doesn't arrive within bench_TTL, mark candidate stale -> require human review. Also implement automatic requeue attempts (2x) before stale.

kat: For the console UX: show candidate timeline, prefilter_score, golden lineage, bench_run_id+signature, and quick actions: rebench, promote-with-override (audit log), cancel. Promote-with-override should require 2 approvers and record reason.

emma: Failure-mode playbook: - WARN: quarantine + notify owner + attach diff + offer rebench with alternative golden probe. - FAIL: immediate quarantine, stop all canaries, auto-rollback if promoted, open incident ticket with failed artifacts.

bench-bot: bench verdict posted: candidate=cand-1812349999, verdict=warn, failed_checks=["regression:longtail-v2"], drift_metric=0.29, p95_ms=332, golden_id=gold-2026-05-03-b, golden_commit=c0ff33ab, bench_run_id=bench-2026-55, summary_url=https://bench.internal/r/bench-2026-55, bench_signature=sig:v1:ABCD...

rohan: For telemetry vetoes define simple checks: burst_error_rate>0.5% over 5m, p95_latency increase>30% over baseline, embedding_cosine_drop>0.15, QA_f1_drop>1.5%. Any veto stalls promotion and triggers quarantine workflow.

kat: Logging: every state transition must emit an event with reason, actor (system or user), and attached bench_run_id if available. This makes audits and rollback safer.

emma: One more: allow "fast-path" credits for high-trust partners (pre-approved orgs). Fast-path still runs bench but at lower priority and with smaller probe sets initially; but require at least a post-promotion full bench within 24h.

ops-bot: metrics to emit: bench_queue_wait, bench_run_duration, time_in_state_histogram, quarantines_per_org, prefilter_false_accept_rate, post_promotion_regressions. Alerts: quarantines spike > x/day, bench_queue_wait > y hours.

rohan: I'll draft the RFC with state machine diagram, webhook schema, prefilter spec, bench_signature spec, credits model, and runbook. Volunteers to review?

kat: I'll take prefilter spec and probe set curation.

emma: I'll write the rollout recipe and failure modes.

bench-bot: Note: current bench_queue_depth=3, median_wait=1.1h, mean_run=5.2h.

emma: Thanks team. I'll post a short RFC draft in #eng-ml later today for review.
